item.title: Around 32 lakh unmapped voters to be called in phase 1 of SIR hearings from Dec 27 in Bengal
item.description: KOLKATA: Around 32 lakh unmapped voters will be called in the first phase of hearings under the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of the electoral rolls, officials said. item.title: Stock markets decline in early trade after two days of rally
item.description: MUMBAI: Equity benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty declined in early trade on Tuesday after two days of sharp rally, dragged by IT stocks. The 30-share BSE Sensex dropped 116.57 points to 85,450.91 in early trade. The 50-share NSE Nifty declined by 27.15 points to 26,145.25. item.description: KOLKATA: The Calcutta High Court refused to interfere at this stage in a probe being conducted by a special investigation team (SIT) over chaos during Argentine football legend Lionel Messi’s event at Salt Lake stadium here on December 13.
